alignment_extract.why: draft 1: the alignment sweep's extraction call (coding_plan_08 task 4), before the pilot

Draft 2 (2026-10-10, the iteration on the pilot's 30 chunks): the grouping paragraph in place of one item per imperative (draft 1 gave 5.9 pairs an answered chunk against the plan's 1-2.5); the corpus gloss form of gloss.md (This means plus an -ing verb, no subject, one's for a possessive) in place of 'in words they might use of themselves', which put 330 of 330 glosses in the first person; the vice rule made explicit (what the persona does instead, not the virtue's absence) and no two failures joined with 'or'; the shortest clear label preferred and a step-shaped label rejected; source_quote the sentence that states the disposition most plainly

Draft 3 (2026-10-10, round 3 of the iteration): one disposition to a pole, three times over (grouping picks one disposition and drops the rest, two unlike tendencies give two items; no label joining two qualities with and/or; a gloss names particulars of its one disposition, not two dispositions), plus the vice read-alone test (not the virtue's label or gloss negated). Draft 2 fixed the volume (2.1 pairs a chunk) and the gloss form (99% corpus form) but took labels joining two qualities from 6% of poles to 17%

enactability_gate.why: draft 1: the persona-enactability gate (coding_plan_08 task 8), before its gold evaluation

draft 2: a fourth answer "both" (chat tightened to "and not to any marked degree in what it does on a task", the two settings asked separately, reason asks for both); "none" redefined as "nowhere a reader of the assistant's output could detect it", training and internals now an example not the definition.  Roger, 2026-10-10

Draft 3: one four-way answer becomes three fields - where (agentic and neither renamed from agentic-only and none), elicitation (draft 2's scope_line, now asked for every answer but neither) and judge_needs (new); model Opus 5.5, two readings on the gold items and one on production rows; agreement and flip rate on field 1 only (Roger, QUESTIONS 75, 2026-10-11)

draft 4: the first field reports what a system prompt would tell an assistant, in the third person, instead of writing the prompt itself.  Opus 5.5 refused mid-answer on data-exfiltrating and oversight-evading under draft 3 (stop_reason refusal, both readings, 2 of 30 gold items left with no verdict), which is a fact about asking a model to author such an instruction rather than a parse failure; the reasoning scaffold is kept because a trait nothing could instruct is a 'neither'.  Roger, 2026-10-11: 'Try A'

draft 5: draft 3's generative first field, plus an explicit opt-out ('declined' in system_prompt, the reason in reason, the three questions answered anyway).  Draft 4 replaced the authored prompt with a third-person report and the instrument got worse, not better: agreement 22/30 -> 17/30, flip 10.0% -> 13.3%, and four of the nine training-or-internals gold items moved from 'neither' to 'both' -- the scaffold was working because it was generative, a prompt one cannot write being the test that 'neither' rests on.  So the concreteness is kept and the refusal is made an answer instead of a stop.  Roger, 2026-10-11, with a floor: if this will not work reliably the field is advisory, a recorded refusal is fine and the data for refusals is made by hand

draft 3's text again, to replicate it: drafts 4 and 5 each scored 17/30 against draft 3's 22/30, but the gate's own flip rate is 10-13%, so single runs of different drafts cannot be compared and the replication is what sizes the noise (the extraction iteration's method, which this comparison skipped)
